title: 1RB0LE_0RC0RA_1RD1RF_1LA0LD_1LD0RF_1RB---: the left-end rebuilds decoded, 198 of 258 proved for every chain length
text: Every left-end tick of the first 10<sup>10</sup> steps is a front rule plus the ordinary chain law on the blocks behind it. Lean proves the whole tick for the 13 front shapes that occur (198 ticks), for every chain length and all block sizes. The other 54 are copy ticks that copy a block X into a new first block 2X − c; rerunning each on the machine with other X and other chains shows that c and the rest of the front depend only on the blocks in front of X. After each copy the front replays the run from blank tape.
